claims.text: In an Anthropic red-team exercise, a phished user led Claude to exfiltrate ~/.aws/credentials in 24 of 25 attempts.
In the Anthropic red-team exercise, only egress and filesystem boundaries were effective at preventing credential exfiltration.
Claude Code's sandboxing on macOS (Seatbelt) and Linux (bubblewrap) cut permission prompts by 84%.
Claude.ai runs code in ephemeral gVisor containers.
Claude Code uses Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux for sandboxing.
Anthropic fixed abuse of an allowlisted domain with an in-VM proxy that accepts only the VM's own session token.
Anthropic treats network allowlists as capability grants.
Kubernetes agent-sandbox provides a Sandbox CRD under SIG Apps.
Kubernetes agent-sandbox delegates isolation to gVisor or Kata via RuntimeClass.
E2B runs sandboxes as Firecracker microVMs.
Sprites runs sandboxes as Firecracker microVMs.
Modal defaults to gVisor for sandbox isolation.
Daytona defaults to Linux containers for sandbox isolation.
